    Summer 2026 pedicure trends emphasize a blend of nostalgic pastels, vibrant indulgences, and clean minimalism, featuring creamy pistachio, bright cherry red, sky blue, and sheer "vanilla" white. Key trends include playful shades like butter yellow and lilac, alongside sophisticated options like navy blue and deep, moody plums. 
    Key Summer 2026 Pedicure Trends 
    • Pastel & Soft Shades: Creamy pistachio, soft lavender/lilac, mint green, and butter yellow are dominating as playful yet sophisticated choices for summer.
    • Vibrant "Indulgent" Colors: Bright, cheerful tones like cherry red, poppy, and vibrant coral are popular for a bold look.
    • Minimalist & Sheer: Milky white, vanilla-tinted nudes, and translucent sheer white are favorites for a clean, polished appearance that works for any occasion.
    • Retro & Playful: Pastel shades are often worn as a nod to retro, 2000s-inspired aesthetics.
    • Deep Alternatives: While brights are popular, deep navy and plum-infused wines provide a moody alternative to traditional summer brights. 
    Top Recommended Colors 
    • Pistachio Green: A top choice for a fresh, pastel look.
    • Creamy White/Milky Nude: The go-to for a clean, versatile aesthetic.
    • Sky Blue: Described as a dreamy, summer-friendly shade.
    • Butter Yellow: A trendy, soft yellow capturing a sunny vibe.
    • Cherry Red: A bold, classic option. 
    For a modern twist, many of these colors, especially the pastels, can be elevated with a chrome top coat.
